receipt.equivalence_review: Correct closed-world refusal. The author additionally inspected both INA219 block maps and the INA219 part after power/switch/gate searches. A voltage-range-compatible monitoring IC does not supply the missing selective bleed and hysteresis function. I independently checked those pinned nets and the preserved 3.0–4.2 V per-cell, 50 mA and 4.10/4.05 V requirements. No single-cell or pack-only substitution was made.

refusal.reason: No eligible catalog block found implementing independent monitoring and selective 50 mA bleeding of either cell in the specified 2S pack (3.0–4.2 V per cell, start above 4.10 V, stop below 4.05 V). Cell/balance/battery searches yielded no candidates. Inspection of actual power, switch, protection and INA219 monitor contracts found no two-cell balancing implementation: INA219 blocks provide a single ground-referenced bus reading with a low-ohmic shunt, not two selective bleed paths; the low-side switch lacks a bleed load or current regulator; the draft hardware gate has fixed rail dividers and one combined enable. USB-C 5 V input is available but does not satisfy the missing function. A pack-only monitor or single-cell substitution would violate the brief.
